channel.title: CoolCode Field Notes
channel.description: Practical guides to Canadian public records, weather data, archives and the CoolCode tools.

item.title: How to check SPF, DKIM and DMARC for an email
item.description: Use a received message to find the domain and selector, inspect their DNS records, and compare them with the receiving mail system’s reported results.

item.title: How to check a foreign-currency card charge
item.description: Compare the Canadian amount on a card statement with a reference rate, then calculate the difference in dollars and percent.

item.title: How to check Langley building permits and development applications
item.description: Find the correct Langley municipality, open the original application and distinguish a permit issue date from the date a tracker first saw it.

item.title: How to find previously released federal ATIP records
item.description: Search completed federal access-to-information summaries, identify the right institution and keep a useful shortlist for requesting the released records.

item.title: How to compare a saved weather forecast with the actual temperature
item.description: Follow one Langley or Halifax forecast hour, check its saved prediction against the airport reading, and understand what missing captures and scores mean.

item.title: Reading the CoolCode tools
item.description: What happened to Oxford’s gigabit coverage, why Tor’s Canadian estimate spiked and what else you can learn from 35 CoolCode tools.

item.title: Finding the dial-up page
item.description: Find dial-up in Statistics Canada’s archived internet surveys and read the original PDF pages. Repeat the search locally with Python, Poppler and SQLite.
